list_source: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as published by PlayStation, reported 18 Nov 2026 by Push Square from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles (see Planet GTA 6). 27 trophies are visible from the start; 28 stay hidden until earned. No online trophies: the whole list is single-player.

trophies.guide: The capstone: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 are earned, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Treat it as the finish line, not a task — work the roadmap stages in order and this pops last. Push Square reports it as the list's single Platinum, worth 0 Gamerscore on Xbox.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy coverage — Push Square, GamesRadar+, PC Gamer

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the story, so it unlocks in the first hour of play. Nothing gates it: no choices, no collectibles, just play the mission through to its end. It is a hidden trophy, so it stays secret on PlayStation until you earn it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing its missions in order — story-only and unmissable. One thing to do before the chapter ends: Lucia's balcony meditation counts toward Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy reported as possibly missable, and Output Lag reports that meditation spot disappears after Chapter 1. Do it while you are still in Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (missable meditation, no mission replay)

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 by playing its missions in order. This is the chapter where both protagonists become playable, and most of the trophy list opens up from here, so use it to sample the activities and side content as you go. The asterisks in the name are how PlayStation itself prints it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 by playing its missions in order. Robbery trophies start opening up in Chapters 3 and 4, so from here on, fold the robbery side content into your route instead of leaving it all for after the story. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (robberies in Chapters 3–4, no replay)

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last story chapter before the finale. Before you push into the final mission, make a manual save: with no mission replay, a save at the start of this chapter is your safety net for anything you have not finished yet.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (no mission replay)

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission — one of only two Gold trophies in the list. Make a manual save before you start it: there is no mission replay, so that save is the only way back if you want to redo the finale or mop up anything the ending locks away.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (no mission replay)

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one are unmissable: they unlock by playing the story in order, and the mission's name is the only thing the description gives away — which is why it stays hidden on PlayStation until earned.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission, so expect a setup and a payoff in the same arc — play it through and the trophy follows. Unmissable as part of the story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Like every mission trophy, it unlocks by playing the story in order — no side requirement, no collectible, no choice to get wrong.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Unmissable story progress — the trophy is hidden only because its mission name would spoil the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at the airport. It is a story mission, so it unlocks in order; the airport is also the setting of the separate free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, so learn the runways while you are here.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission story trophies before the finale — once it pops, only the final mission stands between you and the story's end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the 35-task checklist the GTA Vice City Hub lays out, covering story, stranger strands, activities and collectibles. It is the longest grind on the list and the second Gold, so treat it as a cleanup phase after the story, not a separate hunt: almost everything in the roadmap feeds it. Push Square names it the Gold that needs 100%, and EGamers calls it the hardest trophy on the list.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA VI achievements — GTA Vice City Hub (35-task 100% checklist)
GTA 6 trophy list — EGamers (hardest trophy)

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and airtime. The count is tracked by PlayStation and adds up across all of free roam, so fold stunts into normal driving instead of grinding one spot: jump the ramps you pass and thread traffic whenever you travel. It is a volume trophy, not a skill gate.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — 9 types in total. Sample everything early: one race, one shooting-range challenge, one fishing trip, one arcade game, one bowling game, one drone race, one meditation, one hunt and a stunt or two. The trophy pops while you scout the map, and it doubles as a tour of everything the game offers.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The range scores accuracy and speed, so learn each challenge's gold threshold with a weapon class you are comfortable with, then clear them in batches rather than one at a time. Silver-grade because of the volume: 42 golds is a long session, not a hard one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 in total. One win per location is enough, so learn a racing line for each course instead of grinding one: cut the corners the drones allow and keep the drone low where the course lets you. Check off locations as you win them so none is left for the end.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Win a drone race at all 14 locations

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word that matters is different: 20 distinct race events count, so vary the events instead of replaying a favourite. Work through the race types across Leonida — street, off-road and water where the game offers them — and the count climbs with the variety.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The description names the rival, so this is a head-to-head fishing challenge against Cal, not free fishing: find Cal's challenge, then out-fish him on the day. Fishing is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this counts toward two trophies at once.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — one full playthrough of any arcade cabinet is enough. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find and finish it; there is no score requirement in the description. Arcades also count as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — the last mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands are short mission chains found by exploring Leonida; finish Andy's chain to its end. It is hidden because the strand's ending is a story beat.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton — the last mission of Kenton's stranger strand. Stranger strands unlock across Leonida as you explore; follow Kenton's chain through to its final mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy — the last mission of Billy's stranger strand. Like the other character finals, it counts toward Strangers & Freaks as well, so clear the strands in the same sweep.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. There are more than 8 stranger strands, so you can skip the ones you dislike — each strand is a short chain of missions found by exploring, and the five named character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the 8. Finish strands as you find them instead of saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy — the last mission of Randy's stranger strand. Work it in the same sweep as the other character finals so the strand count for Strangers & Freaks climbs together.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone — the last mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. With Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, that is five named finals; together with any three other strands they complete Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: GTABase and PowerPyx flag this as the only trophy that might be missable, and Output Lag reports that Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after that chapter. Do every meditation spot as soon as you find it, and never leave a chapter without checking whether a spot was there. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as your safety net.
trophies.missable_note: Possibly missable — GTABase & PowerPyx flag it; Output Lag reports Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 is gone after that chapter. Meditate everywhere, early.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — EGamers (only possibly missable trophy)
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (Chapter 1 meditation disappears)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at one specific animal rather than any hunt: follow the strand's clues, track the animal with the hunting tools, and take the shot when the game marks the target. It is hidden because Bret's strand is a story beat.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Hunt the unique animal for Bret

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida and a set completes only when every card in it is found, so track sets, not single cards — one finished set is a third of the trophy. Sweep a region fully before moving on, and check your set progress often so you know which set is closest.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game photo and share feature: use it at 100 distinct spots. Spread it out — snap a WAiNK whenever you reach a new landmark and the count climbs on its own while you explore for The Goodtime State. The number 100 is tracked by PlayStation.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's objectives across activities and the world; any 50 completions count. Check the challenges menu regularly and clear the easy ones first — the count is cumulative, so it rewards playing widely rather than grinding one thing.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the wanted level clears — do not fight it out, run. A quiet stretch of countryside or water is the place to vanish.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three shops first, rob them in one run, and keep the wanted level from rising between stops — speed matters more than the take. If the wanted level climbs, the run is over, so pick quiet shops and move fast.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discover means finding a vehicle type for the first time, so drive everything you see and the count rises on its own. Rare and mission vehicles count too, so keep an eye out during story missions — and register the keepers in the Scooter Bros app for On the Spot at the same time.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of five or more, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the meter runs out. A crowded shootout is the place to try it — do not waste it on two enemies in the open.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The description is a joke with a clear instruction: leave the airport in a way the game does not schedule, by taking a plane and departing without following the normal routine. It is hidden because the method itself is the punchline.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks: the description is a joke about them, so expect an encounter with a Rhino and heavy fire. Go in with heavy weapons and a plan to survive the exchange — the trophy is about the encounter, not about stealing the tank.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no one spotting you. Scout the store first, learn its sightlines, then rob it clean and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are seen, the attempt fails — slip out and try again.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — five separate vault robberies, each ending in a clean escape. Space them out and plan the getaway before you go in: the escape counts as much as the robbery. Bank vaults are the biggest robberies on the list, so treat each one as a small heist.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck on the road, take its contents and get away before the response arrives. The escape is part of the trophy, so have your getaway ready before you make the stop.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Rob an armored truck and escape

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas in total. The map fills in as you visit each area, and the remote corners count too, so finish with a sweep of the map edges and the islands. Pair it with the collectible hunts: meditation spots, WAiNK locations and card sets all live in these same 52 areas.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total. One operation per gang: learn which operations belong to which gang before you hit them, and tick the gangs off one by one. Missing a gang means finding its operation, not replaying one you already robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The description is the whole instruction: go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. Output Lag lists this among the trophies with no confirmed trigger yet at launch, so the honest read is the description itself — the bar on Ocean Beach is the place, and the cocktail is the act.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (no confirmed trigger at launch)

trophies.target: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle through a showroom's frontage and out the other side — a smash-and-grab exit, not a quiet one. Output Lag lists this among the trophies with no confirmed trigger yet at launch, so the description is the guide: a vehicle, a showroom, and a loud way out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (no confirmed trigger at launch)

trophies.target: Smash out of a vehicle showroom

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The description names the venue, so go to that alley specifically and play a full game — follow-through means finishing what you start, not just throwing one ball. Bowling also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it reads as a moment with your partner that draws a crowd. There is no confirmed trigger published at launch, so the honest advice is to keep playing with your partner in busy public places; it should land in normal play rather than needing a hunt.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: A partnership moment with mass appeal

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks a count to 500: per EGamers, 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It accumulates across the whole game, so keep making choices — in missions, in the world, in how you handle people — and the count climbs. It is a long grind, not a single act, so do not chase it directly until everything else is done.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — EGamers (500 Criminal Profile actions)

trophies.target: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at succeeding on a second attempt — retry something you failed once and get it right the second time. Output Lag lists this among the trophies with no confirmed trigger yet at launch, so the description is the guide: fail once, then succeed at the retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (no confirmed trigger at launch)

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The description points at witnessing something strange — one of Leonida's odd encounters. Output Lag lists this among the trophies with no confirmed trigger yet at launch: keep exploring the stranger corners of the map and it should trigger on something you were not expecting.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (no confirmed trigger at launch)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun. Output Lag lists this among the trophies with no confirmed trigger yet at launch; the description itself gives the method, so line up a slow pass and swing as you go by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles
GTA 6 trophy list — Output Lag (no confirmed trigger at launch)

trophies.target: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts in batches and the total adds up. Keep robbing and laundering until the $250,000 is reached — it pairs naturally with the robbery trophies, so launder after every job instead of letting bills pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending counts and it adds up across the whole game: weapons, clothes, vehicle upgrades and everything else you buy as you play. Do not force it early — buy what you need as you go and the total climbs on its own by the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Buy every garage on the map; garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy them as you find them rather than leaving the whole set for the end. The money comes from the same jobs that feed Dime on the Dollar.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register 10 vehicles — registrations, not purchases, so vehicles you find count too. Pair it with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover is a candidate to register on the spot.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.label: Official trophy list — PlayStation, via Exophase & PSNProfiles

trophies.target: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app
